name: entropy-reducer
description: Reduce code entropy — do the same thing with less code, safely

plugins.name: entropy-reducer
plugins.description: Multi-agent plugin that finds ways to get the same behavior from less code. Every finding carries evidence, is independently audited, and is verified against a test baseline when applied. Always starts in plan mode; never changes UI/UX or language. Uses haiku for fast passes and sonnet for analysis.
